title: Full-Time Measure of a Restored Term - Session Length Table for Chapters 30, 35 and 1606
content:
When entitlement is restored after a reduction of a Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 term of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), the daily charges of the restored term follow its own measurement. The full-time measure of a restored term follows its length in weeks — the days from term start to term end, both counted, divided by 7:

| Length of the restored term | Full-time measure |
|---|---|
| Shorter than 10 weeks | 6 credit hours |
| At least 10 weeks and shorter than 15 weeks | 9 credit hours |
| Any other length | The full-time standard of 12 credit hours |

**Edges of each band (hypothetical term lengths).**

| Days in the term, both ends counted | Weeks | Measure |
|---|---|---|
| 69 | 9.86 | 6 |
| 70 | 10 | 9 |
| 104 | 14.86 | 9 |
| 105 | 15 | 12 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A five-week summer session of 35 days is measured on 6 credit hours, so 6 credits certified in it are a full load; a 16-week semester of 112 days is measured on 12.
